description.value:
For the duration, you sense the presence of any technologically enhanced items or effects within 30 feet of you. When you sense one this way, you can spend your action to perceive a faint aura around any visible creature or object bearing an enhancement in the area.

The power's sense is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
